name: Help You Through Rough Times
overview: Scripture reveals that God is a steadfast source of help and strength during difficult times, inviting believers to trust in Him without fear. The Psalms affirm that calling upon the Lord in trouble leads to deliverance and healing, while Isaiah emphasizes God's promise to uphold and strengthen His people with His righteous hand. This assurance extends especially to those who are meek and humble, as God delights in beautifying them with salvation, reminding us that our confidence in the LORD is both our refuge and song.
